seoTitle: Cherry Creek School District Calendar 2028-2029 | Holidays & PDF
seoDescription: See the CCSD 2028-2029 All Schools calendar with the August 14 start, May 25 last day, breaks, K-12 non-contact days, K-8 conferences, and official PDF.
heroSummary: Cherry Creek School District starts the 2028-29 All Schools calendar on Monday, August 14, 2028, and the last day is Friday, May 25, 2029. Full closures include Fall Break October 16-20, Winter Break December 22-January 5, and Spring Break March 19-23. K-12 non-contact and K-8 conference dates remain separate from districtwide closures.
calendarNotes: The 2028-29 CCSD All Schools calendar starts students on August 14, 2028 after teacher work days from August 7-11. Fall Break is October 16-20. K-8 non-contact or conference dates include November 10, March 1-2, and May 4. K-12 non-contact dates include November 22, January 8, and February 20. Winter Break runs December 22-January 5, with the second semester beginning January 9. Spring Break runs March 19-23, and the last student day is May 25.

customSections.label: Planning Around the 2028-29 CCSD Calendar
customSections.content: The All Schools calendar gives families a reliable districtwide framework, but not every colored date applies to every student. Keep the K-12 non-contact and K-8 conference markers separate when coordinating siblings across grade levels.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Cherry Creek School District start in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: The first student day on the 2028-29 All Schools calendar is Monday, August 14, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Cherry Creek Winter Break in 2028-29?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 22, 2028 through January 5, 2029. The second semester begins January 9 after the January 8 K-12 non-contact day.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of Cherry Creek school in 2029?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day on the All Schools calendar is Friday, May 25, 2029.

calendarFaqs.q: When are the CCSD K-8 conference dates in 2028-29?
calendarFaqs.a: The PDF marks November 10, March 1-2, and May 4 as K-8 non-contact or conference dates.

calendarFaqs.q: Does this calendar include school-specific Cherry Creek events?
calendarFaqs.a: No. It is the All Schools calendar. Check the assigned school or program for campus-specific events, testing, exams, and graduation.
